shortBio.en: Motörhead bass/vocals; Rickenbacker-through-Marshall roar. Earlier Hawkwind tenure.
shortBio.zh: Motörhead 贝斯/人声；Rickenbacker 过 Marshall 的轰鸣。此前有 Hawkwind 任期。

whyHub.en: Hawkwind → Motörhead: bass-as-rhythm-guitar and speed-metal adjacency invented as one person’s volume policy.
whyHub.zh: Hawkwind → Motörhead：把贝斯当节奏吉他、以及与速度金属的邻接，写成一个人的音量政策。

body.en:
Born 1945. Plays bass in Hawkwind early 70s (Silver Machine era adjacent); fired 1975, forms Motörhead the same year. Ace of Spades (1980) is the citation: overdriven Rickenbacker, barked vocals, rock-and-roll speed without glam polish.

Dies 2015 still touring the Motörhead logo. Hub: one bass/voice method bridges space-rock exit and metal/punk crossover.
body.zh:
1945 年生。70 年代初在 Hawkwind 弹贝斯（Silver Machine 时期邻近）；1975 被撤，同年组建 Motörhead。Ace of Spades（1980）是引用点：过载 Rickenbacker、吼叫人声、无 glam 抛光的摇滚速度。

2015 年仍带着 Motörhead logo 巡演中去世。枢纽：一种贝斯/嗓音方法桥接太空摇滚离队与金属/朋克交叉。

note.en: Pre-Motörhead space-rock bass; band page not in chronicle.
note.zh: Motörhead 之前的太空摇滚贝斯；乐队页尚未入编年史。

note.en: Founding bass/vocals until death; Ace of Spades peak citation.
note.zh: 创始贝斯/人声至去世；Ace of Spades 峰值引用。
